authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7150 nikta, replaced by *nikka in Middle Indo-Aryan, explicitly gives Punjabi nikkā small and Maithili nikāh good. These small/good responses fit that documented semantic range. Exact survey form nikahā is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5427 Section 2 ṭaṅga explicitly includes Bihari ṭā̃gā and Hindi ṭā̃gī axe/hatchet. The retroflex g-bearing central forms fit that branch; unmarked dentals and northwestern tʰoŋ need a branch/transcription check. Exact survey form ṭaŋga is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
